releaseName: The work journal and the desktop client
summary: Three sprints since server-v0.13.0. Work journal (milestone 64, ADR 0011 D17): a new draftloop-mcp stdio MCP server lets the candidate's coding agent record notable work it helped ship with record_work, and list it with list_work, through the server's API and its owner token. Notes are checked, deduplicated, screened for injected instructions and rate limited, and wait as pending until the candidate turns on intake and reviews them in a Work journal panel on the Career evidence page or with draft-loop work-journal in the CLI; an approved note becomes a work-journal knowledge source, sensitive by default for a private project. draftloop-mcp init sets up Claude Code, Codex or another MCP host. Desktop client (milestone 65, ADR 0011 D9): the server's web screen remembers the owner token when it runs inside the new desktop client, which ships separately as desktop v0.9.0. Release sprint (milestone 66): the record archive now holds the record's work journal, and draft-loop-server up prints the web address, the token command and where to get the desktop app.
knownLimitations: The work journal is served with the owner token only; sign-in mode waits for hosted sign-in and a design for the agent's credential (#2079). A full run citing an approved note and walks in Claude Code and Codex are still to do. Staging behaviour is otherwise unchanged.
